crossRefs.note: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might…
(let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
“But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and…
and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and…
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…

translations.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
translations.bsb: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
translations.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
translations.asv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;
